title: Measure BB Annual General Adjustment 5% cap
requirement: The Berkeley Rent Board's annual general adjustment (AGA) for fully covered units is capped at a maximum of 5%; if the formula yields more, the approved AGA may be no more than 5%. Banked unused AGAs may still raise rent to the ceiling.
coverage_conditions: Rental units fully covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance; government-owned or -subsidized units are now fully or partially covered and subject to a rent ceiling.
quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
interaction: Federal or state law prohibits rent control for certain subsidized unit types, which are only partially covered, so a rent ceiling may not apply.

title: Measure BB just cause eviction changes
requirement: Landlords of covered units may evict only for just cause. Nonpayment eviction requires one month's Fair Market Rent in rental debt; failure to sign a substantially similar lease is no longer cause. Eviction notices are due to the Rent Board within three business days.
key_value: 1 month's Fair Market Rent nonpayment threshold
coverage_conditions: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, including government-owned or -subsidized units.
quoted_span: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is no longer allowed for rental debt less than one month of the Fair Market Rent for the unit
